label: Comic Page
description: A laid-out comic page rather than a single image: panels, gutters, a reading order and one panel allowed to break the grid.
prefix: A comic book page with a full panel layout, drawn and inked
suffix: a real page layout: several panels separated by clean white gutters, a clear left-to-right reading order, one panel breaking the grid for emphasis, speech balloons left empty
negative: single illustration with no panels, lettered dialogue text, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage, nsfw
